name: call-from-one-shot
cat:
catflow 0.8
1. Read Text  memo.txt
2. Classify   Qwen3 8B ; "Route it. tags: urgent, normal"
   -> { urgent: call 3 | normal: 4 }
3. Summarize  Qwen3 8B
   resume
4. Save Text  out.txt

lints.message: one-shot routing uses plain edges that converge, not `call` -- only a transcript-keeping decider (Think) can call a tool and get its result back.

name: call-from-think-ok
cat:
catflow 0.8
1. Read Index  kb.index
2. Think       Qwen3 8B ; tools: search, final ; max_visits=8 ; on_budget=final
   -> { search: call 3 | final: resume }
3. Embed       BGE-M3
   resume

name: fork-suggests-parallel
cat:
catflow 0.8
1. Transcribe  Whisper Large v3 ; lang=en
   -> 2 & 3
2. Summarize   Qwen3 8B ; "TL;DR"
3. Translate   Qwen3 8B ; to=French

lints.message: Row 1's fork edge (→ 2 & 3) pushes the same output to multiple chains -- a <parallel> block is the user-facing form for this now.

name: plain-edge-no-fork-ok
cat:
catflow 0.8
1. Read Text  memo.txt
2. Summarize  Qwen3 8B
   -> done

lints.message: Row 1's `Range` produces 10002 items, past the 10000-item guideline -- if a downstream <each> runs a model per item, that's 10002 model calls. Probably intentional; worth a second look if not.

name: remote-decider-unconstrained
cat:
catflow 0.8
1. Read Text  memo.txt
2. Gate       claude-sonnet @ anthropic ; "ship? tags: ship, escalate"
   -> { ship: 3 | escalate: 4 }
3. Save Text  out.txt
4. Save Text  escalate.txt

models:
  claude-sonnet @ anthropic = anthropic/claude-sonnet-4

lints.message: Row 2 (Gate) binds claude-sonnet @ anthropic, which can't constrain its tag — the row that routes this flow runs on a parsed tag, not a guaranteed one. Prefer a local model for the routing step, or read the frame after the run.
